newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: ERPM, Grootvlei management to merge.
newsitem.headline: ERPM, Grootvlei management to merge.

text.p: Randgold and Exploration Co Ltd said on Wednesday it was merging the management of its East Rand Proprietary Mines Ltd and The Grootvlei Proprietary Mines Ltd as a precursor to the proposed rationalisation of its interests on the East Rand.

The effect on the current labour force of the intended rationalistaion had been discussed with employee representatives since last November and the situation would be reviewed between management and unions concerned during the first weekend of February, Randgold said in a statement.
The combined management team would be headed by newly appointed managing director Ferdi Dippenaar.

"Experience at DRD/Rand Leases, Blyvooruitzicht/Doornfontein and Buffelsfontein/Stilfontein has demonstrated the synergistic potential as well as the cost savings which can be realised by putting two mines together under an integrated management structure," Dippenaar said.
"We are confident of achieving the same at ERPM/Grootvlei."
Randgold's Durban Roodepoort Deep Ltd (DRD) merged with Rand Leases Properties Ltd.
Its Blyvooruitzicht Gold Mining Co Ltd merged with Gold Fields of South Africa Ltd's former Doornfontein Gold Mining Co Ltd.
Buffelsfontein Gold Mines Ltd merged with Gengold's former Stilfontein Gold Mining Co Ltd.
